scientific_question: Does the H1.15 parametric carrier signal survive on fresh task identities and fresh rollout seeds under one identical runner SHA?
hypothesis: H1.15 showed heterogeneous parametric positives but was not a strict same-SHA comparison. A confirmation must distinguish a reusable carrier effect from task/partition luck and runner provenance.

experience_source.role: the same frozen H1.14 train-only recovery corpus and H1.15 official SD-LoRA artifact
experience_source.evaluation_access: no H1.16 task, seed, trace, score, or outcome enters memory or training

task_selection.freshness: goal IDs excluded from H0-H1.15 recorded panels and H1.14/H1.15 training source
task_selection.partitions: P1-P4, two task identities per partition

cell_design: 3 arms x 4 task partitions x 8 attempts = 96 attempts; one cell per authorized GPU, eight cells concurrent then four cells

frozen_variables.parametric_artifact: H1.15 official SD-LoRA v4; no refit or sweep

resource_policy.parallelism: first eight independent UUID-bound cells; then four independent UUID-bound cells
resource_policy.isolation: one private WebShop/Lucene seed-root copy per cell

stop_rule: one confirmation only; no rank/LR/epoch sweep, no repeated H1.16 seeds, no prompt rescue

branch_rule.selective_parametric_positive: only then open Q3 confirmation discussion; do not open Q3 from this panel alone
branch_rule.task_specific_or_mixed: retain heterogeneity and keep Q3/H2/D0/retention/SEED closed
branch_rule.invalid: repair runtime/provenance only; do not alter carrier semantics or denominator

claim_boundary: Fresh-task carrier confirmation only; not a general learning, Q3, H2, retention, transfer, or SEED claim.

result.next: Stop adapter micro-variants and keep Q3/H2/D0/retention/transfer/SEED closed; any interface or experience-content change requires a new question and preregistration.
